meta.title: The Curtain Rises
meta.description: Existing to do battle alongside you, living to laugh and rejoice with you.

units.rawText: In the Burbank Sector.
units.displayText: In the Burbank Sector.

spans.text: In the Burbank Sector.

units.rawText: What are you doing giggling to yourself, Kuro?
units.displayText: What are you doing giggling to yourself, Kuro?

spans.text: What are you doing giggling to yourself, Kuro?

units.rawText: I was going over the stream just now. Look at how well-timed that ult was! Reverence went flying super far. Not even my camera saw where she went...
units.displayText: I was going over the stream just now. Look at how well-timed that ult was! Reverence went flying super far. Not even my camera saw where she went...

spans.text: I was going over the stream just now. Look at how well-timed that ult was! Reverence went flying super far. Not even my camera saw where she went...

units.rawText: Nanaka, what do you think I should do for my next stream?
units.displayText: Nanaka, what do you think I should do for my next stream?

spans.text: Nanaka, what do you think I should do for my next stream?

units.rawText: I think anything would be fine. You're always shining; you'll be able to bring happiness to people wherever you go.
units.displayText: I think anything would be fine. You're always shining; you'll be able to bring happiness to people wherever you go.

spans.text: I think anything would be fine. You're always shining; you'll be able to bring happiness to people wherever you go.

units.rawText: Aw, stop heaping praise on me, it's almost embarrassing...
units.displayText: Aw, stop heaping praise on me, it's almost embarrassing...

spans.text: Aw, stop heaping praise on me, it's almost embarrassing...

units.rawText: Kuro can't help but put down her controller and rub her nose sheepishly.
units.displayText: Kuro can't help but put down her controller and rub her nose sheepishly.

spans.text: Kuro can't help but put down her controller and rub her nose sheepishly.

units.rawText: Still, Kuro, I don't think... we can keep doing this forever.
units.displayText: Still, Kuro, I don't think... we can keep doing this forever.

spans.text: Still, Kuro, I don't think... we can keep doing this forever.

units.rawText: What's wrong? Are you feeling uncomfortable in Burbank? Did someone piss you off? I'll get 18 of my followers to go shitpost the crap out of him and then follow up with another 82 sockpuppets.
units.displayText: What's wrong? Are you feeling uncomfortable in Burbank? Did someone piss you off? I'll get 18 of my followers to go shitpost the crap out of him and then follow up with another 82 sockpuppets.

spans.text: What's wrong? Are you feeling uncomfortable in Burbank? Did someone piss you off? I'll get 18 of my followers to go shitpost the crap out of him and then follow up with another 82 sockpuppets.

units.rawText: That's not what I meant. This is the third time I've received news about the Oasis, the new base for the Exiles from the Cloud Sector.
units.displayText: That's not what I meant. This is the third time I've received news about the Oasis, the new base for the Exiles from the Cloud Sector.

spans.text: That's not what I meant. This is the third time I've received news about the Oasis, the new base for the Exiles from the Cloud Sector.

units.rawText: Compared to staying in Burbank, I'd prefer to go to the Cloud Sector and meet my friends.
units.displayText: Compared to staying in Burbank, I'd prefer to go to the Cloud Sector and meet my friends.

spans.text: Compared to staying in Burbank, I'd prefer to go to the Cloud Sector and meet my friends.

units.rawText: Hm, then you should go, what's— Ah, there it is, I remember this part from the playback!
units.displayText: Hm, then you should go, what's— Ah, there it is, I remember this part from the playback!

spans.text: Hm, then you should go, what's— Ah, there it is, I remember this part from the playback!

units.rawText: There are people there I know IRL. I didn't dare go over before because I was afraid of facing them...
units.displayText: There are people there I know IRL. I didn't dare go over before because I was afraid of facing them...

spans.text: There are people there I know IRL. I didn't dare go over before because I was afraid of facing them...

units.rawText: But I think I've found my courage now.
units.displayText: But I think I've found my courage now.

spans.text: But I think I've found my courage now.

units.rawText: Isn't that nice? Ah, that was a good punch!
units.displayText: Isn't that nice? Ah, that was a good punch!

spans.text: Isn't that nice? Ah, that was a good punch!

units.rawText: I want to build a new theater there. Do you want to come with me?
units.displayText: I want to build a new theater there. Do you want to come with me?

spans.text: I want to build a new theater there. Do you want to come with me?

units.rawText: Oh, that was a good shot too! Ooh, nice kill! ...Sorry, what did you just say, Nanaka?
units.displayText: Oh, that was a good shot too! Ooh, nice kill! ...Sorry, what did you just say, Nanaka?

spans.text: Oh, that was a good shot too! Ooh, nice kill! ...Sorry, what did you just say, Nanaka?

units.rawText: ...Kuro. Will you accept my invitation to watch me perform in the Oasis and be my part-time manager?
units.displayText: ...Kuro. Will you accept my invitation to watch me perform in the Oasis and be my part-time manager?

spans.text: ...Kuro. Will you accept my invitation to watch me perform in the Oasis and be my part-time manager?

units.rawText: ...Is... is something wrong? Is that a no?
units.displayText: ...Is... is something wrong? Is that a no?

spans.text: ...Is... is something wrong? Is that a no?

units.rawText: Ah, well, it's okay, I can go on my own too...
units.displayText: Ah, well, it's okay, I can go on my own too...

spans.text: Ah, well, it's okay, I can go on my own too...

units.rawText: No-no-no, how could I possibly say no? I'd be more than willing! In fact, I'd be super happy to!
units.displayText: No-no-no, how could I possibly say no? I'd be more than willing! In fact, I'd be super happy to!

spans.text: No-no-no, how could I possibly say no? I'd be more than willing! In fact, I'd be super happy to!

units.rawText: This is great, Nanaka! It's decided, then! We'll build a brand new stage in the Oasis and let your song echo throughout the cloud server!
units.displayText: This is great, Nanaka! It's decided, then! We'll build a brand new stage in the Oasis and let your song echo throughout the cloud server!

spans.text: This is great, Nanaka! It's decided, then! We'll build a brand new stage in the Oasis and let your song echo throughout the cloud server!

units.rawText: Then I hope you'll continue your streaming there. Songs and laughter ought to exist side by side.
units.displayText: Then I hope you'll continue your streaming there. Songs and laughter ought to exist side by side.

spans.text: Then I hope you'll continue your streaming there. Songs and laughter ought to exist side by side.

units.rawText: And with that, the Dolls announce that they're going to leave the Burbank Sector in their final livestream.
units.displayText: And with that, the Dolls announce that they're going to leave the Burbank Sector in their final livestream.

spans.text: And with that, the Dolls announce that they're going to leave the Burbank Sector in their final livestream.

units.rawText: Some of the comments express regret, others ask them to stay, and some agents say they'll buy videos from the Trader outpost there.
units.displayText: Some of the comments express regret, others ask them to stay, and some agents say they'll buy videos from the Trader outpost there.

spans.text: Some of the comments express regret, others ask them to stay, and some agents say they'll buy videos from the Trader outpost there.

units.rawText: Of course, others are indifferent, and some even hope they'll leave sooner rather than later, though the Dolls happily dismiss that as unimportant information...
units.displayText: Of course, others are indifferent, and some even hope they'll leave sooner rather than later, though the Dolls happily dismiss that as unimportant information...

spans.text: Of course, others are indifferent, and some even hope they'll leave sooner rather than later, though the Dolls happily dismiss that as unimportant information...

units.rawText: Or rather, Kuro wanted to shitpost back at every one of them, but Nanaka stopped her.
units.displayText: Or rather, Kuro wanted to shitpost back at every one of them, but Nanaka stopped her.

spans.text: Or rather, Kuro wanted to shitpost back at every one of them, but Nanaka stopped her.

units.rawText: As they leave, Burbank's lights remain on.
units.displayText: As they leave, Burbank's lights remain on.

spans.text: As they leave, Burbank's lights remain on.

units.rawText: Kuro opens her eyes and stretches herself lazily.
units.displayText: Kuro opens her eyes and stretches herself lazily.

spans.text: Kuro opens her eyes and stretches herself lazily.

units.rawText: It was tiring, yet satisfying... Felt pretty good.
units.displayText: It was tiring, yet satisfying... Felt pretty good.

spans.text: It was tiring, yet satisfying... Felt pretty good.

units.rawText: Well, well, have the potato chips been unlocked yet?
units.displayText: Well, well, have the potato chips been unlocked yet?

spans.text: Well, well, have the potato chips been unlocked yet?

units.rawText: Unfortunately not.
units.displayText: Unfortunately not.

spans.text: Unfortunately not.

units.rawText: Why!? You're running a scam here; I'm going to expose you on the Oasis forums!
units.displayText: Why!? You're running a scam here; I'm going to expose you on the Oasis forums!

spans.text: Why!? You're running a scam here; I'm going to expose you on the Oasis forums!

units.rawText: Kuro puffs up her cheeks angrily, but seeing that I'm not taking the bait, she shrugs it off.
units.displayText: Kuro puffs up her cheeks angrily, but seeing that I'm not taking the bait, she shrugs it off.

spans.text: Kuro puffs up her cheeks angrily, but seeing that I'm not taking the bait, she shrugs it off.

units.rawText: Forget it. I've got my own stuff to do.
units.displayText: Forget it. I've got my own stuff to do.

spans.text: Forget it. I've got my own stuff to do.

units.rawText: Is Nanaka waiting for me outside?
units.displayText: Is Nanaka waiting for me outside?

spans.text: Is Nanaka waiting for me outside?

units.rawText: You'll have to see for yourself. I've been watching over you all this time, so I don't know what's going on out there.
units.displayText: You'll have to see for yourself. I've been watching over you all this time, so I don't know what's going on out there.

spans.text: You'll have to see for yourself. I've been watching over you all this time, so I don't know what's going on out there.

units.rawText: You've been "watching over me all this time"? That's so cringe not even the galgame MCs from 40 years ago would say that.
units.displayText: You've been "watching over me all this time"? That's so cringe not even the galgame MCs from 40 years ago would say that.

spans.text: You've been "watching over me all this time"? That's so cringe not even the galgame MCs from 40 years ago would say that.

units.rawText: If you like me so much, then watch my first Oasis livestream later on!
units.displayText: If you like me so much, then watch my first Oasis livestream later on!

spans.text: If you like me so much, then watch my first Oasis livestream later on!

units.rawText: There'll be a special guest on that stream—
units.displayText: There'll be a special guest on that stream—

spans.text: There'll be a special guest on that stream—
